About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

jobs.title: Limpieza para Edificio de Apartamentos (Lunes a Viernes 7am-3pm y Domingo 2pm-7pm)
jobs.description_text:
Descripción General del Puesto:

El Portero Residencial es responsable de mantener la limpieza en las áreas comunes de los sitios asignados. Sus funciones incluyen el mantenimiento general, como lavado a presión, limpieza de ventanas, recolección de basura y tareas de limpieza rutinarias. El portero también apoya en la preparación y limpieza de eventos cuando sea necesario y responde a las inquietudes de limpieza conforme surgen. El puesto requiere responsabilidad, atención al detalle y la capacidad de trabajar de manera profesional y cortés con el personal de la propiedad, los residentes y los visitantes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Garantiza que todas las áreas comunes, incluidos aceras, vestíbulos, baños y espacios públicos, se mantengan limpias y presentables.
  • Completa las tareas diarias de limpieza y mantenimiento según lo asignado por el Gerente Senior de Operaciones, Limpieza.
  • Realiza lavado a presión en las áreas asignadas por la gerencia.
  • Se presenta en la ubicación asignada usando el uniforme aprobado de ParkX Porter.
  • Llega a la ubicación asignada antes del inicio del turno de trabajo.

About the role

As a Customer Success Manager I at 3rdRisk, you're the person who turns a new customer into a confident, successful one. You own onboarding from kickoff to go-live — guiding organizations through implementation and configuration until they're getting real value from the platform — and you stay with them afterwards as their trusted point of contact, running the relationship through regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews.

As a Senior Staff Analyst, you’ll own a named portfolio of our most significant customers from a security perspective, and get ahead of what they need — their regulatory environment, their audit calendar, their risk appetite, their control expectations — well enough to have the evidence ready before the request arrives. You’ll lead customer security audits hands-on, sit across from customer security teams as a peer rather than a form-filler, and build account security plans that make the next assessment predictable instead of painful. 

This is deliberately a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You’ll spend your time in audits, in customer conversations, and in the detail of controls and evidence — not in a management chain. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description_text:
About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

jobs.title: Manager, International Statutory & Technical Accounting
jobs.description_text:
GAQ127R102

Mission

Databricks is growing at an incredible pace, and our London hub is at the heart of our international expansion. As our international footprint has scaled to 27 entities through a period of rapid growth, we need a technical expert to bring structure, consistency, and automation to how we account for, report on, and stay compliant across them. Reporting to the Director, International Accounting, this is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys bringing order to a fast-evolving environment and getting hands-on with the judgments that matter most.

You will drive consistent application of our group accounting policy across all international entities — owning the local GAAP interpretations, bridge methodologies, and disclosure standards they follow, and ensuring these align with the policy set by our US technical accounting team.
